'''2007 New York State Championship Eric Goodnough LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Eric Goodnough]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' TIGIH
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
